items.text: Should the PDF include the company's VAT number and address block, or only the line items and totals?
items.answer: Include the VAT number and the full address block, same as the emailed receipt.

items.text: Where should the download be offered: on the receipt page only, or also as a bulk download from the order history?
items.recommendation: Receipt page only for now; bulk download needs a background job and is better as its own story.

items.text: The receipts service stores amounts in cents. Should the PDF round tax per line or on the total?
items.recommendation: On the total, to match the amount charged.
